name: Strange Tales of Tang Dynasty
overview: General Lu Lingfeng and Detective Su Wuming uncover supernatural mysteries and hidden conspiracies threatening the empire during Emperor Xuanzong’s reign.

production_companies.name: 北京长信影视传媒有限公司

seasons.name: Season 1
seasons.overview: In Chang'an City, a mysterious herb called Black Tea causes a stir, coinciding with a string of missing bride cases. General Lingfeng of the Jin Wu guards is tasked with uncovering the truth. Along the way, he encounters Su Wuming, a sharp detective and disciple of Di Renjie. Together, they unravel a web of supernatural mysteries and dark conspiracies threatening the city.

seasons.name: To the West
seasons.overview: The Tang Dynasty's grandeur continues, but hidden dangers lurk beneath the prosperity, and a storm is brewing. Various forces are on the move, triggering frequent mysterious incidents among the common people. What kind of supernatural mysteries will Lu Lingfeng and Su Wuming encounter on their perilous journey? The road to the west is unpredictable.

seasons.name: To Chang'an
seasons.overview: Investigators Lu Lingfeng and Su Wuming return to Chang’an under the pretense of escorting a royal tribute, but soon find themselves entangled in a series of baffling crimes and political conspiracies. As they uncover hidden truths behind each case, their pursuit of justice draws them into a dangerous struggle that could decide the fate of the empire.

results.name: Side Story of Fox Volant
results.overview: Hu Fei stepped into the arena to avenge his father and grew from a reckless teenager who was brave and reckless to a generation of heroes who cared about the common people and served the country and the people.

results.name: May All Woman Be Free
results.overview: When Zheng Qi discovers her husband's affair and his secret transfer of their shared assets, she hatches a plan. With her nanny posing as an investor, she sets a trap to reclaim what’s rightfully hers.

results.name: Are You Safe?
results.overview: It tells the story of Qin Huai, Zhou You and Chen Mo, the "Three Musketeers" who traveled in the online world. Although they have different personalities, they all adhere to the initial intention of "science and technology to be good". The three men joined forces in the process of confronting an Internet illegal gang again and again. Suspicion to the story of liver and gallbladder.

results.name: The Kidnapping Day
results.overview: A father turned clumsy kidnapper and a genius child get tangled in unexpected circumstances.

results.name: The Wind Blows From Longxi
results.overview:
The year is 228 of the Common Era, and China is divided into Three Kingdoms, which find themselves at odds with each other. A seemingly decisive battle has just taken place, with the Shu army clashing with the Wei. But military leaders in the state of Shu believe that the battle’s result was swayed by a campaign of misinformation – with faulty information leading to a critical misjudgment. They believe that this was all masterminded by Chen Gong (Chen Kun), a powerful spy believed to be located somewhere in Wei lands.

“The Wind Blows from Longxi” is a 2022 Chinese drama series that was directed by Lu Yang.

results.name: Romance in the Alley
results.overview: The Zhuang, Lin, and Wu families live in a small alley in Suzhou during the late 1970s. As societal changes unfold, the parents and children in each household experience dramatic shifts in their fates, forever altering their lives and relationships.

results.name: Jumong
results.overview: Jumong  examines the life of Jumong Taewang, founder of the kingdom of Goguryeo. Few details have been found in the historical record about Jumong, so much of the series is fictionalized.

results.name: Joy of Life
results.overview: Zhang Qing, a present-day college student in culture and history major wants to study in professor Ye's postgraduate class, so he decides to write a historical fiction to elaborate his perspective of analyzing ancient literature history with modern concept. In the fiction, Zhang himself acts as a young man Fan Xian with mysterious life who lives in a remote seaside town of Kingdom Qing in his childhood, under the help of a mysterious mentor and a blindfolded watchman. Fan goes to the capital when he grows up, where he experiences plenty of ordeal and temper. Fan persists in adhering the rule of justice and goodness and lives his own glorious life.

results.name: Presumed Innocent
results.overview: A horrific murder upends the Chicago Prosecuting Attorney's Office when one of its own is suspected of the crime—leaving the accused fighting to keep his family together.

results.name: Wednesday
results.overview: Smart, sarcastic and a little dead inside, Wednesday Addams investigates twisted mysteries while making new friends — and foes — at Nevermore Academy.

results.name: Bobby's World
results.overview: Bobby Generic lives in a typical suburban neighborhood and uses his overactive imagination to discover a world of daring adventure, incredible wonder and lots of laughs — all in pint-sized perspective.

results.name: Stranger Things
results.overview: When a young boy vanishes, a small town uncovers a mystery involving secret experiments, terrifying supernatural forces, and one strange little girl.

results.name: The Good Doctor
results.overview: Shaun Murphy, a young surgeon with autism and savant syndrome, relocates from a quiet country life to join a prestigious hospital's surgical unit. Unable to personally connect with those around him, Shaun uses his extraordinary medical gifts to save lives and challenge the skepticism of his colleagues.

results.name: She-Hulk: Attorney at Law
results.overview: Jennifer Walters navigates the complicated life of a single, 30-something attorney who also happens to be a green 6-foot-7-inch superpowered hulk.

results.name: The Last of Us
results.overview: Twenty years after modern civilization has been destroyed, Joel, a hardened survivor, is hired to smuggle Ellie, a 14-year-old girl, out of an oppressive quarantine zone. What starts as a small job soon becomes a brutal, heartbreaking journey, as they both must traverse the United States and depend on each other for survival.

results.name: Euphoria
results.overview: A group of high school students navigate love and friendships in a world of drugs, sex, trauma, and social media.

results.name: The Falcon and the Winter Soldier
results.original_name: The Falcon and the Winter Soldier
results.overview: Following the events of “Avengers: Endgame”, the Falcon, Sam Wilson and the Winter Soldier, Bucky Barnes team up in a global adventure that tests their abilities, and their patience.

results.name: Kaguya-sama: Love Is War
results.original_name: かぐや様は告らせたい～天才たちの恋愛頭脳戦～
results.overview: Considered a genius due to having the highest grades in the country, Miyuki Shirogane leads the prestigious Shuchiin Academy's student council as its president, working alongside the beautiful and wealthy vice president Kaguya Shinomiya. The two are often regarded as the perfect couple by students despite them not being in any sort of romantic relationship.
